references.text: Parallel account of the tribe of Dan conquering Laish (here called Leshem) and renaming the city after their forefather, Dan.
Dan was born as Rachel's son through Bilhah, and his name means 'he judged.' This explains the naming of the city after the patriarch Dan.
Jacob's blessing over the tribe of Dan, describing Dan's character as the ancestor of the tribe that conquered Laish.
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Dan, comparing Dan to a lion's cub leaping forth from Bashan.
The census of the tribe of Dan in the wilderness, showing the size of the tribe before the settlement of the land.
The original inheritance allotted to the tribe of Dan, which proved insufficient and led to the conquest of Laish.
